items.title: JM Smucker Rises on Outlook; Intuit Down on Full-Year Forecast | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Intuit (INTU) shares are down after the tax-preparation software company gave a full-year forecast for both adjusted earnings and revenue that was weaker than expected. - Abercrombie & Fitch (ANF) is climbing as it raised its outlook for the year after logging higher second-quarter profit and sales, driven by improving demand across multiple geographies. - JM Smucker (SJM) shares are rising as it raised its full-year outlook for sales and profit, buoyed by growth in its Uncrustables sandwiches and coffee.
